source: 737 Opinion
target: 737 Opinio

source: After having the messenger dispatched to deliver the letter, Lumian sat at his desk, gazing at the dark curtains that seeped in the crimson moonlight, patiently awaiting Madam Magician’s arrival.
target: Postquam nuntius ad epistulam tradendam missus erat, Lumian ad scrinium suum sedebat, intuens obscuras cortinas, in quas rubro lunari lumine permeabatur, adventum Magistrae Magicae patiens exspectans.

source: After an indeterminate period of time, a resplendent starlight emerged from the dark room, coalescing into the figure of Magician.
target: Post aliquod indefinitum tempus, lux stellaris splendida ex conclavi obscuro apparuit, in figuram Magistrae Magicae coalescens.

source: She had changed into a brownish‐yellow cotton dress with white trimmings.
target: Mutaverat se in tunicam ex cotone flavidentem cum albis ornamentis.

source: “Good evening, Madam Magician,” Lumian said with a glance around. “I have something important to discuss.”
target: “Bonum vesperum, Magistra Magica,” inquit Lumian, circumiaculis intuens. “Aliquid magni momenti habeo ad disserendum.”

source: Magician grasped his meaning and immediately condensed the surrounding darkness into an illusory glass barrier, curling up to block out the infiltration of the crimson moonlight and the sounds from outside.
target: Magistra Magica eius sensum intellexit atque statim circumstantias tenebras in fictum obstaculum vitrei coaravit, se convolvens ut penetrationem rubri lunaris luminis atque sonorum ex foris impediret.

source: “What’s so important?” Madam Magician inquired once secrecy was ensured.
target: “Quid est tam magni momenti?” quaesivit Magistra Magica, cum secretum confirmatum esset.

source: Lumian conjured a blazing white flame to use as a chandelier.
target: Lumian flammam albidam ardentem evocavit ut lampadario uteretur.

source: After a few moments of silence, he said, “I’ve confirmed the origins of the lizard‐like elf.”
target: Post aliquot momenta silentii, inquit, “Origines elfi lacertiformis comprobavi.”

source: “It’s not an evil god from outside the barrier?” Madam Magician wore a thoughtful expression.
target: “Num non est deus malus ex extra claustra?” inquit Magistra Magica, vultu cogitativo.

source: Lumian’s lips curled into a slight smile. “An evil god in a way, but one not from outside the barrier.”
target: Labia Lumiani in levem risum convoluta erant. “Deus malus aliquatenus, sed non ille ex extra claustra.”

source: Magician frowned and said, “Give me the details.”
target: Magistra Magica frontem contraxit et dixit, “Da mihi singula.”

source: Lumian recounted in his deep voice his pact with Penitent Baynfel and the corresponding negative effects.
target: Lumian, voce profunda, narravit pactum suum cum Penitente Baynfel et effectus adversos consequentes.

source: He described seeing the True Creator idol and a lizard‐like elf in the secret cathedral of the Aurora Order, as well as the illusory scene suspected to be a divine kingdom.
target: Descripsit quod vidisset idolum veri creatoris et elfum lacertiformem in cathedrali secreto Ordine Aurorae, necnon scenam illusoriam, quae regnum divinum fore suspicabatur.

source: Madam Magician didn’t interrupt him, listening attentively.
target: Magistra Magica eum non interpellavit, attente auscultans.

source: Then, she let out a long sigh and said, “In fact, I had suspected that the lizard‐like elf was related to Him, but whether it was the Spectator pathway’s Mythical Creature form or the Hanged Man pathway’s Mythical Creature form, they were clearly different from that elf.”
target: Tum illa longum suspirium exhalavit et dixit, “Revera suspicabar elfum lacertiformem ad Eum pertinere, sed sive in forma creaturae mythicae per viam Speculatorum sive in forma creaturae mythicae per viam Pendenti Viri, plane diversa erant ab illo elfo.”

source: Nothing similar had manifested in the past five to six years.
target: Nulla similia apparuerant per annos quinque ad sex praeteritos.

source: Additionally, the two experts at decrypting and deciphering dreams were more inclined to believe that the elf came from an evil god outside the barrier.
target: Praeterea, duo periti in somniorum interpretandis magis inclinabantur credere elfum ex deo malefico extra claustra venisse.

source: This led me to abandon that guess.
target: Id me ad eam coniecturam deserendam adduxit.

source: From the looks of it, that entity had been involved in Cordu’s catastrophe for a long time.
target: Ex aspectu, illa entitas diu in calamitate Cordi implicata fuit.

source: That’s the only explanation that’s complete.
target: Haec sola explicatione plena est.

source: How could He, who’s been listening and watching, not notice such a major incident that has been unfolding for so long and involves members of the Curly‐Haired Baboons Research Society?
target: Quomodo potuit ille, qui auscultavit et observavit, talem rem gravissimam, quae diu evoluta est et membra Societatis Inquisitionis Simiarum Crispatorum implicat, non animadvertere?

source: How could He not take advantage of the situation?
target: Quomodo non potuit ex huius rei opportunitate uti?

source: “What does He want?” Lumian’s expression subtly contorted.
target: “Quid vult ille?” inquit Lumian, vultu subtiliter contracto.

source: Magician stared at Lumian for a few seconds before sighing again.
target: Magistra Magica Lumianum per paucos momenta aspiciens deinde iterum suspiravit.

source: “I can only confirm one goal. That is to create a Beyonder capable of rapid digestion and rapid advancement along the Hunter pathway.
target: “Unum solum propositum confirmare possum. Id est, Beyonder creare, qui celeriter digerendi atque celeriter in via Venatoris progredi possit.

source: “Think about it. It’s been just over half a year since you became a Hunter.
target: Cogita de hoc. Iam paulo plusquam dimidium anni est ex quo Venator factus es.

source: You’re already a Sequence 5 Beyonder, and your Reaper potion has been greatly digested.
target: Iam es Beyonder ordinis quinto, et potio tua Reaper magno modo digesta est.

source: Perhaps in two to three months, you can consider breaking through to godhood and advancing to Sequence 4, becoming a demigod.
target: Fortasse in duobus ad tribus mensibus, te in divinitatem transgredi atque ad Ordinem Quartum progredi, factus semideus, considerare poteris.

source: “On this ‘journey,’ whether it was the fake Angel status brought about by sealing Termiboros, the obtained boons of the Inevitability pathway, or some tempering and digestion opportunities filled with calculated arrangements, they all contributed significantly to your growth.
target: In hoc itinere, sive falsus status Angeli per sigillum Termiboros obtentus, sive dona obtenta per viam Inevitabilitatis, sive occasiones temperationis et digestionis cum consiliis computatis, omnes ad incrementum tuum significanter contulerunt.

source: “He wants a Red Priest and is pushing for a decisive battle between the Red Priest and the Primordial Demoness.
target: Ille Sacerdotem Rubrum desiderat et pugnam decisivam inter Sacerdotem Rubrum et Daemonissam Primordialem impellit.

source: “I was worried that your advancement might be going too smoothly, but now it seems that a price has already been exacted for what fate bestowed, and a deposit has been paid.”
target: “Timebam ne progressio tua nimis leniter eveniret, sed nunc videtur pretium iam solutum esse quod fata imposuerunt, atque depositum datum esse.”

source: Under the blazing white flames, Lumian spoke in a deep, raspy voice, “I’d rather remain an ordinary person.”
target: Sub flammis albidis ardentibus, Lumian, voce profunda et rauca, dixit, “Malim manere hominem ordinarium.”

source: Madam Magician shook her head with a complex smile.
target: Magistra Magica caput concussit cum risu composito.

source: “As the apocalypse approaches, with Aurore’s background and condition, even if no catastrophe had occurred in Cordu, it’s inevitable that you’ll encounter one eventually.
target: “Cum apocalypsis appropinquet, et cum Aurore condicione atque originibus, etiamsi in Cordo nulla calamitas evenisset, inevitabile est ut tandem tibi occurrat.

source: Have you forgotten the helplessness and pain of being an ordinary person in that catastrophe?
target: Nonne oblitus es inopiam ac dolorem, qui hominem ordinarium in illa calamitate affligit?

source: Lumian clenched his fists involuntarily and lowered his head.
target: Lumian pugnos involuntarie stringens et caput deiecit.

source: “I-I just don’t want to obtain power this way.”
target: “N-nolo potentiam hoc modo adipisci.”

source: Madam Magician didn’t dwell on the topic and said, “He definitely has ulterior motives.
target: Magistra Magica de re non multum versata est et dixit, “Profecto, ille ulteriora consilia habet.

source: For example, a humanoid Sealed Artifact like you can effectively gather evil god influences around you wherever you go, exposing their schemes in advance and giving us more time to deal with them.”
target: Exempli gratia, artificium sigillatum humanoide ut tu efficaciter colligere potest influxus deorum malorum circa te, ubicumque eris, consilia eorum ante ostendendo et nobis tempus amplius tribuendo ad eos tractandos.

source: Lumian remained silent and didn’t respond.
target: Lumian tacitus remansit et non respondit.

source: Madam Magician glanced at him and asked with an obvious sigh, “What’s your next move?”
target: Magistra Magica eum aspexit et, cum suspirio manifesto, quaesivit, “Quid deinceps agas?”

source: Lumian’s body trembled slightly, as if he couldn’t suppress his emotions.
target: Corpus Lumiani paulo trepidavit, quasi affectus suos reprimere non posset.

source: Gritting his teeth, he said, “I want to punch Him!”
target: Dentes stringens, dixit, “Illum percutire volo!”

source: Upon saying this, Lumian’s eyes turned bloodshot.
target: His dictis, oculi Lumiani sanguine rubefacti sunt.

source: To be honest, he had never harbored a firm desire to seek revenge on a deity.
target: Ad veritatem, numquam firmum desiderium habuerat deum vindicare.

source: His original plan was to eliminate the key members of April Fool’s and the Sanson family of the Sinners organization.
target: Primum consilium eius erat principales membra April Fool’s atque familiam Sanson de organizatione Peccatorum exstirpare.

source: Then, he would work hard to become an Angel and extract most of Termiboros’s strength.
target: Deinde laboraret constanter ut Angelus fieret et maximum Termiboros robur extraheretur.

source: Then, he would release the weak Angel of Inevitability and kill Him.
target: Deinde dimitteret Angelum infirmum Inevitabilitatis et Eum interficeret.

source: He knew that the source of Cordu’s catastrophe was actually the entity known as Inevitability.
target: Sciebat fons calamitatis Cordi revera esse entitatem quae Inevitabilitas appellatur.

source: However, due to the vast disparity between them and his natural fear of deities, he had only occasionally cursed and spoken harsh words.
target: Attamen, ob ingentem discrepantiam inter eos ac eius naturalem deorum timorem, tantum aliquando maledictus et verba aspera dixit.

source: He hadn’t truly put the other party on his revenge list.
target: Non vere alterum in indicem ultionis suae posuerat.

source: And now, he wanted those damned deities to fall from heaven, like meteors streaking through the night sky!
target: Et nunc, volebat ut illi deorum maledictorum de caelo caderent, sicut meteora per caelum nocturnum fulgentia.

source: Madam Magician looked at Lumian with a serious expression and asked, “Do you know what you mean by that?”
target: Magistra Magica, vultu serio Lumianum intuentem, inquit, “Scis quid hoc significet?”

source: “I know,” Lumian nodded slowly. “I’ve been waiting all day before requesting to meet you because I’ve been questioning myself seriously.”
target: “Scio,” inquit Lumian, lente annuens. “Totum diem exspectavi antequam te convenire petissem, quia me ipse serio interrogaveram.

source: He had questioned himself again and again, sometimes in anger, sometimes in sorrow.
target: Se iterum atque iterum interrogaverat, aliquando in ira, aliquando in dolore.

source: When he calmed down a little, he questioned himself again.
target: Cum paulo sedatus esset, se iterum interrogavit.

source: Madam Magician regarded him with a familiar pity in her eyes.
target: Magistra Magica eum intuens, oculis pietatis nota, aspiciebat.

source: This time, Lumian knew clearly what she was pitying.
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian clare intellexit quid illa misere teneret.

source: A human yearning to punch a deity.
target: Homo desiderans deum percutere.

source: Lumian gazed back at the Major Arcana card holder, his gaze unwavering.
target: Lumian aspiciebat tenentem chartarum Maioris Arcanae, oculis immotis.

source: After a while, Magician nodded slightly and said, “You’re telling me the target because you want me to provide effective advice on your idea and make it a little more feasible?”
target: Post aliquod tempus, Magistra Magica leviter annuit et dixit, “Narras mihi scopum, quia vis ut consilium efficax de tua idea praebeam et eam paulo magis efficacem reddam?”

source: “Yes, my suggestion is that before Mr. Fool awakens to some extent, endure your impulses and work hard to improve yourself.
target: “Ita, suadeo ut, priusquam Dominus Fool aliquatenus evigilaverit, impulsus tuos sustineas et constanter te meliorem facias.

source: Only by becoming a demigod can you have a chance to sit at that table of cards—of course, that depends on whether you appear there in the form of cards or chips.
target: Solum semideus factus, occasio tibi dabitur ut ad mensam chartarum sedeas—scilicet, id pendet ex forma tua, sive chartarum sive tessarum.

source: Don’t be disheartened. It’s the same for you, me, and the other demigods.
target: Noli contristari. Idem est pro te, me, et ceteris semideis.

source: Our will and choices can also play an important role at critical moments.
target: Voluntas nostra et electiones etiam partes maximas in momentis decisivis agere possunt.

source: We can also exploit the card players.
target: Luditores chartarum quoque ad nostram utilitatem adhibere possumus.

source: Lumian asked in a deep voice, “Will Mr. Fool—will he help me?”
target: Lumian voce profunda quaesivit, “Num Dominus Fool mihi adiuvabit?”

source: Madam Magician nodded solemnly. “Yes.”
target: Magistra Magica sollemniter annuit. “Ita.”

source: Unknowingly, her eyes grew brighter. “Mr. Fool will protect us. All of us are willing to make sacrifices for this world, but we can’t be sacrificed.”
target: Nescite, oculi eius clarior facti sunt. “Dominus Fool nos proteget. Omnes parati sumus pro hoc mundo sacrificia ferre, sed sacrificari non possumus.”

source: Lumian suddenly let out a sigh of relief, as if he had lost all strength.
target: Lumian subito suspirium levationis emisit, quasi omnem fortitudinem amisisset.

source: He couldn’t stand steadily, and his body swayed slightly.
target: Non potuit stabile stare, et corpus eius paululum vacillabat.

source: He had been suppressing his emotions with all his might until now.
target: Affectus suos omni vi usque ad hunc tempus reprimebat.

source: Madam Magician looked at him and pondered for a moment before saying, “I must remind you that that entity should already be aware of your thoughts.
target: Magistra Magica eum aspiciens paulisper meditata deinde dixit, “Moneo te, nam illa entitas iam de tuis cogitationibus conscius esse debet.

source: This is because you displayed an abnormality in front of His idol.
target: Nam coram eius idolo anomaliam ostendisti.

source: I’m not criticizing you; I’m just stating a fact.
target: Non te critico; tantum rem dico.

source: In that situation, even Clowns and Spectators would find it difficult to control their emotions and expressions, let alone an Ascetic like you.
target: In illa condicione, etiam scurrae et spectatores vix possent affectus et vultum suum moderari, cujus modi te, ascetam, moderare non possis.

source: “I know…” Lumian replied with difficulty.
target: “Scio…” inquit Lumian, lente annuens.

source: Before Madam Magician exposed him, he had harbored a glimmer of hope.
target: Antequam Magistra Magica eum detegeret, parvam spem in corde suo fovebat.

source: Magician chuckled and said, “That’s also a positive thing. The fact that you’re still alive suggests that you’re still useful to Him and can be used.
target: Magistra Magica subridens dixit, “Id quoque res positiva est; quod adhuc vivus es, significat te Eius usui esse posse.”

source: You haven’t repaid the full price that fate has exacted of you.
target: Non solvesti pretium integrum, quod fata ex te exiguerunt.

source: As long as you don’t give up on yourself or participate in actions that can disrupt His important plans, He will ignore your hatred.
target: Dum te ipsum non deseruis aut in rebus, quae consilia Eius turbabunt, non participes, Eius odium negleget.

source: He might even continue to allow you to encounter opportunities and obtain things until you step onto the stage He has decided for you.
target: Forsitan etiam te permittet ut occasiones capias et res obtineas, donec in scaenam, quam Eius pro te designavit, ascendas.

source: It’s frustrating, but that’s the reality.
target: Molestum est, sed hoc est veritas.

source: In the eyes of an existence like Him, you are currently just a speck of dust.
target: In oculis entitatis similis Eius, nunc es tantum particula pulveris.

source: He can reduce you to dust at any time without worrying about your thoughts.
target: Ille te in pulverem quovis tempore redigere potest, sine cura de cogitationibus tuis.

source: After a long silence, Lumian asked in a slightly hoarse voice, “You mean, before Mr. Fool awakens, I’m to make full use of that entity’s arrangements?”
target: Post longum silentium, Lumian voce paulo rauca quaesivit, “Id igitur significas, antequam Dominus Fool evigilaverit, ut totis entitatis praeparatis uti deberem?”

source: Magician nodded slightly and said, “Using an enemy’s resources to strengthen yourself is also a way of seeking revenge.
target: Magistra Magica leviter annuit et dixit, “Ad te corroborandum hostis opibus uti quoque est modus ultionis quaerendi.

source: Of course, this requires greater caution and restraint.
target: Scilicet, hoc maiorem cautionem et temperantiam requirit.

source: As I mentioned earlier, a price is always exacted for what fate has bestowed.
target: Ut antea dixi, pretium semper exigitur pro eo quod fata tribuunt.

source: You have to weigh whether you’re willing to pay the corresponding price in the future.
target: Oportet ponderare num paratus sis pretium futurum solvere.

source: Lumian looked down at the floor illuminated by the incandescent white light and said, “Okay.”
target: Lumian aspexit ad solum, quod luce albidis incandescentibus illustratum erat, et dixit, “Bene.”

source: He then asked, “When will Mr. Fool begin awakening?”
target: Deinde quaesivit, “Quando Dominus Fool evigilabit?”

source: “No one knows,” Madam Magician replied with a smile.
target: “Nemo scit,” inquit Magistra Magica cum risu.

source: “But there’s no need to be disheartened by this answer.
target: “Sed nihil est te contristare ex hoc responsu.

source: I foresee that we tarot card holders will play an important role in this matter.
target: Praedico nos, tenentes chartas Taroticas, partes maximas in hac re agere.

source: Let’s work hard together.
target: Conemur simul operari.

source: “How do we?” Lumian pressed.
target: “Quomodo faciemus?” inquit Lumian instanter.

source: Madam Magician pondered for a moment and said, “First, focus on yourself. Then, wait patiently for the right opportunity.”
target: Magistra Magica paulisper meditata et dixit: “Primum, cura te ipsum; deinde patienter opportunitatem rectam exspecta.”

source: The right opportunity? Lumian couldn’t fathom how they, the Minor Arcana card holders, were involved in awakening Mr. Fool.
target: “Opportunitas recta?” Lumian non potuit intellegere quomodo illi, tenentes chartas Minoris Arcanae, ad Dominum Fool evigilandum implicarentur.

source: All he could do was cautiously ask, “Madam, did you deliberately place Penitent on the messenger list?”
target: Omnia quae facere poterat, tantum cautus quaesivit, “Magistra, num Penitent voluntarie in indice nuntiatorum posuisti?”

source: Without Baynfel’s negative influence, he wouldn’t have had a chance to see the lizard‐like elf in the True Creator’s hidden cathedral.
target: Sine influxu negativo Baynfel, non haberet occasionem elfum lacertiformem in cathedrali secreto veri creatoris videre.

source: “Yes and no,” Madam Magician replied.
target: “Et sic et non,” respondit Magistra Magica.

source: “I know he has a certain connection to that entity.
target: “Scio eum certum nexum ad illam entitatem habere.

source: I believe our collaboration with the Aurora Order is fragile.
target: Credo nostram collaborationem cum Ordine Aurorae esse fragili.

source: You were sent as an undercover agent, not a true member.
target: Misitus es ut speculator occultus, non ut verus membrum.

source: You might encounter certain problems in the future, and there’s a chance that he will bring about new possibilities.
target: Fortasse aliquas difficultates in futurum occursuras, et facultas est ut novas possibilitates afferat.

source: That’s why I placed him on the messenger list to see if fate will allow you to choose him.
target: Ideo eum in indice nuntiatorum posui, ut videam an fata tibi sinant eum eligere.

source: I never expected this to unveil a very important mystery.
target: Numquam exspectavi hoc revelare mysterium valde momenti.

source: Lumian had long grown accustomed to Madam Magician’s cryptic responses.
target: Lumian iam diu consueverat responsionibus crypticis Magistrae Magicae.

source: He swiftly filtered through her thoughts.
target: Celeriter per eius cogitationes perscrutatus est.

source: He spoke in a deep voice, “Madam, I wish to explore Mr. Hanged Man’s Blue Avenger soon.”
target: Voce profunda dixit, “Magistra, mox Mr. Hanged Man’s Blue Avenger explorare volo.”
